attributes.title: MSCA Conference 2027: Igniting Minds, Inspiring Futures
attributes.summary:
The Maryland School Counselor Association holds its 2027 conference on Sunday and Monday, March 7 and 8, at the Hyatt Regency Chesapeake Bay resort in Cambridge, on Maryland's Eastern Shore. The theme is "Igniting Minds, Inspiring Futures: The Path to Infinite Possibilities," and Ashley Wright is listed as keynote speaker with "Passion, Purpose, Position" on March 8.

Alongside the main program, MSCA offers a Lauryn's Law training worth 15 MSDE certification hours for one credit, sold separately for $50. The conference page does not list NBCC or other counseling CE hours, so school counselors who also hold a counseling license should confirm credit details with the association.

Through January 15, 2027, the full conference costs $220 for professional and retiree members, $110 for student members and $280 for non-members; standard rates are $255, $120 and $315. One-day passes and the awards soiree are sold separately. Advance registration ends March 3, refunds end February 7, and the $139 hotel block is held until February 8, 2027.
